questions: In channelSupportText(), the code unconditionally accesses d.request[0] for the nrc string formatting, but only checks k < d.length in the loop above. If the C library can produce dropped requests where d.length == 0, this would be undefined behavior. Is d.length guaranteed to be >= 1 for dropped requests?
